description: This Java class defines the PatientProgramAttribute, which extends BaseAttribute and implements Attribute, representing an attribute of a PatientProgram in the OpenMRS system. It includes properties and methods for managing the association with PatientProgram and attribute identification.

classes.name: PatientProgramAttribute
classes.description: Represents a specific attribute associated with a PatientProgram in the OpenMRS system, including its ID and the associated PatientProgram.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this PatientProgramAttribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this PatientProgramAttribute.

methods.name: getPatientProgram
methods.description: Retrieves the PatientProgram associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setPatientProgram
methods.description: Associates a PatientProgram with this attribute.

methods.name: getPatientProgramAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of this PatientProgramAttribute.

methods.name: setPatientProgramAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID for this PatientProgramAttribute.
